idea: Themed weeks, week four, Know your states day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor; a viewer editor read it and changed nothing, before voicing.
description: In FY 2024-25 Karnataka had 381 units registered under the Software Technology Parks (STP) scheme and Tamil Nadu 371, about the same. Karnataka's units exported ₹3,08,909 crore and Tamil Nadu's ₹51,537 crore, 6.0 times as much.

Karnataka's units made 44.9% of the ₹6,88,194 crore exported by STP-scheme units; Maharashtra's, 20.6%. Per unit, Karnataka ₹811 crore and Tamil Nadu ₹139 crore, an average over units of very different sizes. Only STP-scheme units are counted, not all IT exporters: a 2025 Commerce reply puts all STPI-registered units' exports at ₹9.43 lakh crore for FY 2023-24, against ₹6.37 lakh crore here. State totals, not per person; a count of units, not their size.
source: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, reply to Lok Sabha Starred Question No. 344 of 12 August 2026: units registered under the Software Technology Parks (STP) scheme and their exports, by state, FY 2024-25 (all-India: 2,042 units, ₹6,88,194.11 crore; 2025-26 estimated). Only STP-scheme units are counted, not all IT exporters: a 2025 Commerce reply (Q 5008) puts all STPI-registered units' exports at ₹9.43 lakh crore for FY 2023-24, against ₹6.37 lakh crore here. State totals, not per person.

done: Numbers editor opened the Lok Sabha answer's PDF (Starred Q 344, 12 Aug 2026, 4 pages, read as page images and text) and compared the two hand-typed tables cell by cell by program: units, 26 states and UTs by 3 years (78 cells) plus the printed total row (2,059 / 2,042 / 2,125), and exports, 24 states and UTs by 3 years (72 cells) plus the printed total row; 0 differences, and the state rows add to the printed totals.

Recomputed with python3 -I: units 2024-25 Karnataka 381, Tamil Nadu 371; exports Karnataka 3,08,909.11, Tamil Nadu 51,536.55, ratio 5.99; Karnataka's share 44.99%, Maharashtra 20.65%; per unit Karnataka 810.8, Tamil Nadu 138.9, India 337.0. Ran the 16 'tests' by hand through the builder's own function (the builder then ignored them for this script type; it has since been changed to run them).

Fixed before voicing: the scope now says 'software-park (STP) scheme units' in the hook, title, cards, map note and source (the claim would mislead as 'Karnataka's software exports'); the share card compared Karnataka with Telangana as if it were next, but Maharashtra is second, so the comparator is now Maharashtra; the per-unit card carries 'An average over units of very different sizes'. Viewer editor read it and made no change.

Claude checked every figure quoted in this pack's description, Instagram text, X post and pinned comment against the built data.json (screen text, voice lines and the builder's own checks); none is new.

Not proven: that Q 5008 equals STP plus non-STP (SOFTEX-only) units (inferred from STPI's FAQ and a 2022-23 split quoted by Factly from Dataful); that special economic zone units sit outside the table (a legal reading, not stated); that a unit is counted once however many floors or addresses it has
